statement: Membership-publication candidate/planning consumption of projection-readiness state is routed through the single semantic owner instead of an alternate construction path. A planning readiness entry that embeds the owner-built frozen core (projectionReadinessContract) is consumed as: readiness semantics = the embedded owner core BY REFERENCE, plus entry-LOCAL planning facts (the priority-recovery-pending publication overlay, today exactly dimensions[CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_ELIGIBLE]=true) composed as a cheap frozen envelope over the core with visible provenance — never by re-normalizing the entry; resolveProjectionReadinessStateForEntry becomes that thin consumer/adapter and performs full normalization ONLY for genuinely contract-less entries (the preserved fallback, which also serves as the in-receipt equivalence oracle). Invariants: (B1) many candidate derivations with fresh entry objects at one (node, unchanged semantic generation) leave readiness semantic normalization at the owner's build count — candidate/derivation count never determines readiness-normalization count — and candidate outputs remain equal on the consumed decision surface to the pre-repair full-rebuild across a fixture matrix including the overlay case (red-on-revert: restoring entry-identity-owned normalization must red); (B2) entry identity is irrelevant — fresh entries A!==B at the same node+generation+semantic inputs resolve to the SAME owned core reference; (B3) entry-local planning differences still change planning/candidate outcomes while the shared core may be identical — no over-hoisting; (B4) an authoritative readiness generation change is consumed immediately — no stale planning result from an old entry memo; (B5) per-node isolation preserved — node A and node B entries consume their own per-node cores, no cluster-wide sharing; (B6) during candidate derivation, normalization attributable to the entry-identity path is ZERO (instrumented via the landed entry-memo-miss sync-section) with all readiness normalization attributable to the owner. Scope owns ONLY the ProjectionReadinessEvidenceOwner -> membership-publication candidate/planning consumption edge; it does NOT own candidate scheduling cadence, membership-publication policy, sync readiness call frequency, source-observation freshness, or critical placement.
